nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, role checks, receivers of value and minted tokens.
Block time (now) used for expirations, liveness windows, voting rounds and the testable timer.
owner address gating onlyOwner; set from _msgSender() in the constructor.
Deployer address used by the restricted modifier in Migrations.
Stores the last completed migration id and is passed into upgraded contracts.
Address of the test Timer used to override live block time.
Stored synthetic timestamp initialised from now and mutated by setCurrentTime.
Role id whose holders may withdraw ETH/ERC20 from the contract.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by nonReentrant / nonReentrantView.
Mapping of roleId to Role (roleType, managingRole, member(s)); the base of all access control.
Counter incremented inside reentrancy-protected functions to prove guard effectiveness.
Attacker-controlled calldata used to re-enter the target contract.
Guard preventing infinite recursive reentrancy cycles in the checker.
ERC20 collateral token that fees and positions are denominated in.
Last time fees were paid; used to compute the regular fee window and to avoid double-paying in a block.
Cumulative (1-effectiveFee) multiplier used to convert raw to fee-adjusted collateral.
Mapping of sponsor to PositionData (tokens outstanding, withdrawal request, raw collateral).
Global synthetic token debt used for collateralization ratio checks.
Raw global collateral; only ever adjusted through _addCollateral/_removeCollateral.
Synthetic token contract minted/burned by positions.
Contract expiry time; changed by emergencyShutdown.
Lifecycle state (Open / ExpiredPriceRequested / ExpiredPriceReceived) gating expire and settle.
DVM price captured at settlement for redeeming tokens.
Per-sponsor array of LiquidationData records.
Raw collateral locked in liquidations; part of the profit-from-corruption pool.
Window during which a liquidation may be disputed.
Required collateral to token redemption value ratio deciding dispute outcome.
Percentage of locked collateral posted as dispute bond.
Per-address WETH balance credited on deposit and debited on withdraw/transferFrom.
Nested allowance map consumed by transferFrom.
Internal balance ledger updated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Internal allowance ledger.
Total token supply changed by mint and burn.
Monotonic snapshot counter incremented by _snapshot.
Per-second oracle fee applied to profit-from-corruption.
Flat final fee per currency charged on price requests.
Array of registered financial contract addresses.
Maps contract address to validity and array index.
Maps party to its registered contracts and index lookup.
UMA voting token used to snapshot balances and mint rewards.
If set, only the migrated address may interact, redirecting the system.
Array of unresolved price request ids.
Per-round snapshot id, inflation rate, gat percentage and rewards expiry.
Minimum participation percentage required for a valid resolution.
Old-token to new-token conversion rate used as a divisor.
One-shot guard preventing double migration per holder.
Mapping of interface name to implementation address used for dynamic dispatch.
Whitelist of price identifiers accepted by the oracle.
Per-user withdrawal request amount, request timestamp and raw collateral.
Blocks all state-changing methods until initialize() is called.
Mapping identifier,time to available price data.
Array of pending query points; deleted via swap-and-pop in pushPrice.
Only address allowed to trigger the Umip15 upgrade.
Voting contract migrated away from.
Finder whose implementation addresses and ownership are rewritten during the upgrade.
Only address allowed to trigger the Umip3 upgrade.
Finder target of the Umip3 upgrade.
Finder used to look up the Voting contract address.
Maps hot key to its deployed DesignatedVoting contract.
Array of governance proposals with transactions and request time.
Finder used to resolve oracle and identifier whitelist addresses.
Mock spot price settable by anyone via setPrice.
Mock price map keyed by keccak256(from,to) and used for swap payout math.
TokenFactory used to deploy synthetic tokens for new EMPs.
Status (None/In/Out) per whitelisted address.
Append-only array of addresses ever added to the whitelist.
Transfers ownership; guarded by onlyOwner and a non-zero check.
Sets _owner to address(0) under onlyOwner.
Writes last_completed_migration behind the restricted modifier.
Calls setCompleted on an arbitrary address supplied by a restricted caller.
Sets the mock timer time; callable by anyone when timerAddress is set.
Returns timer time or block timestamp depending on timerAddress.
Sends ETH to msg.sender via Address.sendValue behind onlyRoleHolder.
Transfers ERC20 tokens to msg.sender via safeTransfer.
Modifier that checks and sets the _notEntered guard around the guarded body.
Adds a member to a shared role after exclusivity and manager checks.
Removes a member from a shared role.
Replaces the holder of an exclusive role.
Enqueues a price request; restricted to registered or migrated contracts.
Stores a commit hash for a voter in a round; blocked once migrated.
Verifies the reveal hash against the commit and records the vote weight.
Computes and mints rewards for correct votes in a resolved round.
Requires an ECDSA signature matching msg.sender to snapshot the round.
Owner-only redirect of the oracle to a new voting contract.
External wrapper that creates a new snapshot id.
Computes and pays oracle fees, updating lastPaymentTime and the cumulative fee multiplier.
Creates/augments a position, minting synthetic tokens against deposited collateral.
Burns synthetic tokens and returns pro-rata collateral.
Withdraws collateral while checking the global collateralization ratio.
Post-expiry redemption using the resolved oracle price.
Post-expiry transition to ExpiredPriceRequested and oracle price request.
Governor-only premature settlement that resets the expiration time.
Drains untracked token balances to the excess token beneficiary.
Liquidates a sponsor position and pulls tokens and the final fee from msg.sender.
Disputes a pending liquidation by posting a dispute bond and requesting a price.
Distributes liquidation collateral to sponsor, liquidator or disputer based on state.
Resolves a pending dispute into success/failure using the oracle price.
Proposer-only creation of a governance proposal and DVM price request.
Executes an approved transaction via a low-level call after deleting it from storage.
Private assembly call forwarding data and value to an arbitrary target.
Credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value.
Debits the caller then transfers ETH with msg.sender.transfer.
Moves WETH balances and decrements allowance from the caller.
Updates sender and recipient balances and emits Transfer.
Increases total supply and credits a recipient.
Decreases total supply and debits an account.
Pulls the oracle fee amount in ERC20 from msg.sender.
ContractCreator-only registration of a financial contract and its parties.
Swap-and-pop removal of a party from the calling contract.
Performs an arbitrary low-level call back into msg.sender.
Assembly low-level call used to attempt reentrancy.
Fallback that re-enters the caller with the stored txnData and reverts on success.
Increments the counter then calls the attacker contract.
Increments the counter then calls the attacker contract with a view selector.
Recursive nonReentrant function used to test the guard.
Recursively calls itself through a low-level call to address(this).
Private helper doing an unchecked counter increment.
One-shot migration of a holder's balance using the stored rate.
Deploys a DesignatedVoting for msg.sender; one per hot key.
Governor-only upgrade rewriting Finder entries and contract owners.
Existing-governor-only multi-address upgrade and ownership transfer.
Unpermissioned price push that mutates verifiedPrices and the pending array.
Owner-only external call to a financial contract's emergencyShutdown.
Deploys a SyntheticToken and grants minter/burner/owner to msg.sender.
Recovers a signer from a hash and 65-byte signature using ecrecover.
ecrecover call relying on signature length and s/v range checks; non-unique signatures are a risk.
Assembly call(gas(), to, value, ...) with attacker-influenced target and calldata.
Assembly call(gas(), to, value, ...) enabling reentrant callbacks.
msg.sender.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(data)) with unchecked target.
address(token).call(data) low-level token interaction; external call may re-enter.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwarding all gas to an untrusted recipient.
msg.sender.transfer(wad) after balance mutation; state updates precede the value transfer.
counter += 1 performed without SafeMath (unchecked arithmetic).
Assembly sstore(proposals_slot, _startingId) writes array length directly.
msg.sender.transfer(amountReturn) in the mock swap payout path.
uint128(registeredContracts.length.sub(1)) truncating downcast for storage index.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership.
ETH amount requested from withdrawable.withdraw.
Collateral amount supplied to ppm.create.
Number of synthetic tokens minted by ppm.create.
Sponsor address whose position is liquidated.
Price identifier being committed to in commitVote.
Commit hash stored for the voter in commitVote.
Recursion depth for the reentrancy-guard test.
Success flag returned by the assembly call in _executeCall.
Voter whose rewards are computed and minted.
ECDSA signature proving the caller is an EOA when snapshotting.
Local proposal id derived from proposals.length in propose.
Array of party addresses registered with a financial contract.
Amount of WETH withdrawn in WETH9.withdraw.

edges.reason: Constructor sets _owner from _msgSender() so the ownership gate depends on caller identity.
onlyOwner compares _owner to _msgSender() before transferring ownership.
restricted modifier compares msg.sender to owner.
setMigrated is protected by onlyOwner derived from msg.sender.
Payout branch in withdrawLiquidation is selected by msg.sender identity.
executeProposal is permissionless but forwards msg.value and executes stored transactions.
resetMember is gated by onlyRoleManager which checks roles against msg.sender.
Timer constructor stores now into currentTime, making stored time block-dependent.
getCurrentTime falls back to now, so liveness checks depend on block.timestamp.
Round snapshot requires the current block time to be in the reveal phase.
expire is gated by onlyPostExpiration which compares getCurrentTime to expirationTimestamp.
createLiquidation reverts when getCurrentTime exceeds the caller-supplied deadline.
expire and emergencyShutdown compare getCurrentTime against expirationTimestamp.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
setCompleted writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration.
upgrade is restricted to the owner recorded at deployment.
setCurrentTime forwards to the Timer at timerAddress.
getCurrentTime reads the Timer's stored currentTime when configured.
countAndSend hands control to an attacker contract via callSender.
countAndCall hands control to an attacker contract via callSender.
callSender builds calldata and performs the low-level call.
The call targets msg.sender, an untrusted contract that can re-enter.
fallback invokes _executeCall to attempt re-entering the caller.
_executeCall performs the assembly call with stored txnData.
Assembly call targets msg.sender, allowing reentrant execution.
withdraw debits the balance and then transfers ETH to msg.sender.
transfer sends value to msg.sender which may execute a fallback.
settleExpired transfers collateral before pulling and burning synthetic tokens.
redeem transfers collateral before transferFrom and burn of synthetic tokens.
withdrawLiquidation transfers collateral after removing raw liquidation collateral.
withdrawErc20 calls token safeTransfer to msg.sender.
createLiquidation pulls tokens and final fee from the caller via safeTransferFrom.
executeProposal deletes the transaction then performs the low-level call.
_executeCall performs an assembly call to a stored target address.
The low-level call may invoke an arbitrary target that re-enters the governor.
withdraw forwards ETH through Address.sendValue to msg.sender.
sendValue uses recipient.call with full gas, enabling reentrant recipients.
countThisRecursive calls address(this) which re-enters the nonReentrant guard.
Recursive nonReentrant call exercises the guard via _count and self-recursion.
_count performs counter += 1 without overflow protection.
registerContract downcasts the array length computation into a uint128 index.
recover relies on ecrecover and manual s/v validation for authentication.
snapshotCurrentRound authenticates the caller by recovering the signature and comparing to msg.sender.
upgrade requires msg.sender to equal the stored governor address.
upgrade requires msg.sender to equal the stored existingGovernor address.
emergencyShutdown compares msg.sender with the Finder-resolved FinancialContractsAdmin address.
newDesignatedVoting enforces one contract per msg.sender via the mapping.
createToken grants minter, burner and owner roles to msg.sender.
callEmergencyShutdown is gated by onlyOwner.
propose reads proposals.length and pushes a new proposal into storage.
executeProposal reads and deletes entries from the proposals array.
create updates the caller's PositionData and global counters.
withdraw decrements position collateral through internal balance helpers.
redeem down-sizes or deletes the sponsor position.
payRegularFees writes the current time into lastPaymentTime.
payRegularFees scales cumulativeFeeMultiplier by the effective fee.
payRegularFees increases allowance and transfers the collateral currency.
requestPrice pushes a new id into pendingPriceRequests.
commitVote stores the commit inside the round vote instance.
revealVote reads the snapshotted voting token balance of the voter.
retrieveRewards mints voting tokens as rewards.
migrateTokens flips hasMigrated for the token holder.
migrateTokens divides the old balance by the stored rate.
pushPrice writes the verified price into the mapping.
pushPrice mutates requestedPrices via swap and delete.
payOracleFeesErc20 pulls the fee from msg.sender.
addMember writes the shared role membership mapping.
removeMember writes the shared role membership mapping.
resetMember writes the exclusive role member in the roles mapping.
snapshot increments _currentSnapshotId and emits Snapshot.
_transfer updates the internal balance ledger.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
deposit credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value using unchecked +=.
transferFrom decrements the spenders allowance without SafeMath.
withdrawLiquidation removes collateral from rawLiquidationCollateral.
dispute adds the dispute bond to rawLiquidationCollateral.
_settle writes settlementPrice and state into the liquidation record.
trimExcess reads the contract collateral balance to compute the excess.
createLiquidation records msg.sender as the liquidator.
dispute records msg.sender as the disputer.
newOwner is written into _owner after the zero-address check.
amount is forwarded as the ETH value in Address.sendValue.
collateralAmount is added to the position and transferred in.
numTokens is added to tokensOutstanding and minted.
sponsor selects the position to liquidate and the liquidations array index.
identifier selects the price request being committed to.
hash is stored as the voter's commit for the round.
n controls the recursive self-call depth in the guard test.
success carries the assembly call outcome back to the caller.
voterAddress is used to look up snapshotted balances and mint rewards.
signature must recover to msg.sender for the snapshot to be authorized.
id is derived from proposals.length and used to build the DVM identifier.
parties are iterated and registered against the new contract address.
wad is checked against balanceOf and then transferred out.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter exists only to be validated and stored into _owner by transferOwnership.
The parameter feeds directly into the ETH value sent by Address.sendValue inside withdraw.
The parameter is consumed only by the collateral bookkeeping and transfer logic of create.
The parameter is consumed only by the minting and debt accounting of create.
The parameter selects the position and liquidation array entry used by createLiquidation.
The parameter only keys the price request lookup inside commitVote.
The parameter is stored as the commit value inside commitVote.
The parameter only controls the recursion branch of the guard test function.
The local holds the assembly call result returned by _executeCall.
The parameter is used solely for reward lookup and minting inside retrieveRewards.
The parameter is used only by ECDSA.recover to authorize the snapshot call.
The local is derived from proposals.length and used to construct the price identifier in propose.
The parameter is iterated only to attach parties to the registered contract.
The parameter is the amount checked against balanceOf and transferred out in WETH9.withdraw.
